For the Atmosphere sofa, a few simple care steps can help you get the best from it over time:
Wash removable covers as needed: Use a delicate cycle with cold water and mild, fragrance-free detergent. Lay them flat to air-dry, and put them back only when fully dry. Don’t tumble-dry them.
Clean spills promptly to help prevent stains, and follow the care label for the specific cover.
Keep it comfortable: Atmosphere has layered-foam seating and generally needs less cushion maintenance than loose, fiber-filled styles like Ciello and Gaia.
Choose Aquaforte Velvet if you want extra help with everyday messes: It has excellent stain resistance, but it isn’t stain-proof, so clean spills promptly.
Atmosphere’s fabric covers are removable and machine-washable, and the full covers can be replaced later if you want to refresh the look.
